clue.text: For her day of triumph. Phoebus returns

parts.note: VE Day, Victory in Europe Day in 1945, was the great day of triumph

indicators.note: returns means the word for Phoebus comes back, read from right to left

parts.note: Phoebus Apollo was the Greek sun god, so Phoebus stands for the sun

explanation.surface: A celebration of some woman's victory as the sun god comes back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' turns SUN into NUS after VE. The definition is the 'her' whose day this is: Friday is Venus's day (dies Veneris, French vendredi).
explanation.definitionFit: The goddess of love is the female figure the clue calls 'her', patron of Friday.

clue.text: Relatives can be so resourceful

indicators.note: can be suggests the letters may become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Family members can be really good at coping.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone adaptable and able to do many things is resourceful.

clue.text: At no time indicated by the fourth pip ?

definitions.text: At no time indicated by the fourth pip ?

parts.words: At no time indicated by the fourth pip
parts.note: of the radio time signal's six pips, only the last marks the hour, so the fourth one indicates the time on no occasion

explanation.surface: The fourth beep of the time signal tells you nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The BBC broadcasts six short pips before the hour; the start of the sixth marks the exact time.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that happens on no occasion happens at no time at all.

clue.text: Smiles & Co upset by impropriety

indicators.note: upset means the letters are knocked over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A firm called Smiles and Company is offended by bad behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: A breach of grammar or etiquette is a kind of impropriety.

clue.text: Award celebrity a big decoration

parts.note: a medal is an award
a lion is a celebrity, a social lion

explanation.surface: A famous person receives an honour and a large ornament.
explanation.definitionFit: A medallion is a large medal or ornamental disc, a big decoration.

clue.text: Award judge reversed

indicators.note: reversed means the word for judge is read from right to left

parts.note: to deem is to judge or consider

explanation.surface: A judge overturns a prize.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for a reward or deserved share.

clue.text: He sends off the infernal cobbler

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld, the infernal regions
a cobbler patches shoes, so is a patcher

explanation.surface: A devilish shoe-mender shows people the door.
explanation.definitionFit: One who sends off messages or vehicles despatches them.

clue.text: After a game of cards Edward is sacked.

indicators.note: After puts the name for Edward behind the card game

parts.note: loo is an old card game
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Edward is fired after playing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: A town sacked by an army is plundered.

clue.text: Source of refreshment for the writer'

definitions.text: Source of refreshment for the writer'

parts.words: Source of refreshment for the writer'
parts.note: an author's drink, but the pen is the writer that is refreshed when dipped

explanation.surface: Where an author goes for a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A pen was refilled from a small container of writing fluid.

clue.text: Wanderer showing friend of Pythias up

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Damon and Pythias are the classical model of loyal friendship

explanation.surface: A traveller shows up a famous classical friend.
explanation.definitionFit: A nomad is a wanderer without a fixed home.

clue.text: Tops at the OK Corral ?

parts.note: spinning tops are things that revolve, and at the famous Wild West gunfight the weapons of choice were six-shooters with rotating cylinders

explanation.surface: The best people at a famous Wild West shoot-out.
explanation.definitionFit: Things that spin are tops, and handguns with rotating cylinders were used at the gunfight.

clue.text: Once the pick of the prisons ?

definitions.text: Once the pick of the prisons ?

parts.words: Once the pick of the prisons
parts.note: prisoners were once set to pick old tarry rope apart into loose fibre, so this was what got picked in jails

explanation.surface: Something that used to be the finest of all jails.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose hemp fibre from untwisted old rope was picked by convicts as hard labour.

clue.text: Place for a car if on manoeuvres

indicators.note: troops on manoeuvres are moved about, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Somewhere to park a vehicle if the army is out on exercises.
explanation.definitionFit: A continent is a place on the map.

clue.text: Patch up and get to the top

definitions.meaning: to repair or put right damage
to succeed and rise in the world

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both repair something damaged and become successful.

clue.text: Photographic equipment for a landscape painter ?

definitions.text: Photographic equipment for a landscape painter ?

parts.words: Photographic equipment for a landscape painter
parts.note: camera kit, but also a description of an artist who seeks out scenery to paint

explanation.surface: Camera gear for a painter of scenery.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera's eyepiece frames the scene, and a landscape artist seeks out scenery.

clue.text: Nits back in charge. Outlook dim

indicators.note: in places the turned-round word inside the word for charge

parts.note: to indict is to charge formally with a crime

indicators.note: back means the word nits is read from right to left

explanation.surface: Head lice are returning to someone in charge, and the prospects look gloomy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns NITS into STIN, which 'in' puts inside INDICT. The definition is an adjective phrase: an outlook that is dim is blurred.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dim to the view is blurred and hard to make out.

clue.text: Trade of last month's speaker

parts.note: Dec is short for December, the last month of the year
an orator is a public speaker

explanation.surface: The occupation of last month's guest speaker.
explanation.definitionFit: Painting and paperhanging is a trade.

clue.text: Stage useful in negotiating a rise

definitions.meaning: stairs help you climb a slope

explanation.definitionFit: The word means a stage of progress and also a tread for climbing a slope.

clue.text: It measures the way a saint's. taken round' Bible country

indicators.note: taken round means the saint goes around the country

parts.note: St Peter, the saint
Edom is a kingdom in the Bible

explanation.surface: A saint is guided around the Holy Land on a walk.
explanation.definitionFit: This device counts steps to measure the distance walked.

clue.text: Causing: friction — paper to smooth things over?

explanation.definitionFit: The word describes something harsh, and sandpaper is a gritty sheet for smoothing.

clue.text: Every one a topless fruity beauty

indicators.note: topless means the first letter of the word is removed

parts.note: a peach is a beauty, and a fruit

explanation.surface: Each one is a beauty without a top on.
explanation.definitionFit: Every single one of a group is each of them.

clue.text: Beer wasted by conversion to food

indicators.note: conversion changes the order of the letters in beer wasted

explanation.surface: Beer is wasted by being made into something to eat.
explanation.definitionFit: Sweetbreads are the pancreas or thymus of a calf or lamb, eaten as a delicacy.

clue.text: Secure a get-together in the ring

definitions.meaning: to settle or close a deal

explanation.definitionFit: It means to settle a deal and also boxers' holding each other.

clue.text: To do with the art of taking up. ' arms?

definitions.text: To do with the art of taking up. ' arms?

parts.words: To do with the art of taking up. ' arms
parts.note: it reads like going to war, but arms here are coats of arms, and the art is that of devising and recording them

explanation.surface: Relating to the practice of going to war.
explanation.definitionFit: Heraldry is the art of coats of arms, and this adjective describes it.

clue.text: Treasure. store? Tough, nothing in it!

indicators.note: in places the zero inside the word for tough

parts.note: hard means tough
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A treasure chest is tough with nothing inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A hidden stock of valuables is a cache of treasure.

clue.text: Measure to get to the bottom of

definitions.meaning: a unit of depth, six feet

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a six-foot unit of sea depth and a verb meaning comprehend.

clue.text: Old serf among the Lotus-eaters

indicators.note: among says the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: An ancient slave living among dreamers in Homer.
explanation.definitionFit: Helots were state serfs in ancient Sparta.

clue.text: Therefore, raised this big one

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means the word is read upwards

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore

explanation.surface: Therefore, someone brought up this large person.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant monster of fairy tales is a big one.

clue.text: Chekhov's article has some weight

parts.note: an is the indefinite article
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: The Russian writer's essay is weighty.
explanation.definitionFit: The Russian playwright's first name was this.

clue.text: Boxer maybe a shy one but wild in nature

parts.note: a boxer is a breed of dog
a shrinking violet is a shy person

explanation.surface: A fighter may be timid but is fierce by temperament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' only flags Boxer as an example of a dog. The definition describes the flower: a wild plant found in nature.
explanation.definitionFit: This scentless violet grows wild in British woods and hedgerows.

clue.text: Unknown quantity the reverse of Marengo?

definitions.meaning: someone whose abilities are not known
Marengo was Napoleon's famous grey stallion, so its opposite is a horse of dark colour

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a little-known competitor, and Napoleon's charger was a pale grey.

clue.text: Record stage direction

definitions.meaning: to write down in a register
the instruction telling an actor to come on

explanation.definitionFit: It means to write in a ledger and is also the script instruction to come onstage.
